gap: The hero mock genuinely improved (six named modules, Jan-Jun labels, two dashed gridlines, nothing over the 'Today's Overview' title) but the page still loses on two facts. First, the chip that was moved off the title now sits squarely on top of the module rail: 'Languages supported 5' covers two of the six module rows between 'Inventory' and 'Manufacturing' (a descender is visible poking under its bottom edge), so the exact fix of this round is half-erased by the exact overlap of the last round, and the chip still has no pointer tail and stays bolt-upright while the panel is tilted, so it reads as a sticker pasted over the product rather than an annotation of it. Second, and bigger: the page's OTHER product image is untouched skeleton. Under 'Built for every team, in every market / Switch between Arabic, English, Hindi, Bengali and Urdu instantly', the browser mock shows one Arabic greeting line and then five grey placeholder bars and three empty grey cards, with the 'العربية' chip clipping the 'حفظ' button, so the one section whose whole claim is 'here is the Arabic UI' shows a screen that has not loaded. Mobile is unchanged too: the fold carries no product image at all, only the 'Languages supported 5' chip sliced by the bottom edge. Against that, Wave's accounting fold is a crisp untilted Transactions table (Select all, Filter/Sort/Auto updates, Date/Description/Account/Category, Nov 12 2025 ATM Check Deposit / Chase Savings, CALIFORNIA WATER / Total Checking / Utilities, All Accounts $25,980.23, cursor mid-hover) and its home fold at least shows a real app under the tilt. Our hero still carries only three round numbers and a chart with no y values. Fix the second image before touching the hero again: give that mock real Arabic invoice rows (customer, date, amount, status) instead of grey bars, move the language chip off the Save button, and pull the hero's 'Languages supported' chip clear of the module rail so all six names read.
